records.name: Doris Deckchair
records.biography_en: Doris Deckchair booked a place with The Floating Buffet. That chair has my towel on it. The incident report lists rolled striped towel and giant sun visor as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: That chair has my towel on it.
